_meta.name: Preventive / AWV frequency limits
_meta.source: AWV cadence is well-established CMS policy and already encoded in this repo (providers.js extractAwv). Only widely-established, repo-consistent entries are seeded here; add others only from real CMS frequency files.
_meta.guardrail: The 271/claims interval is the proof, not this table — findings are INFO-level reminders to confirm before billing.
